title: Deprecate the Image Describer plugin - descriptions and ComfyUI enhance follow the Remote pick
description:
The Image Describer plugin (`js/data/pluginsRegistry.js`, id `image-describer`, dep `qwen3vl-abliterated-clip`) is not a describer of its own: it is the install gate for the ComfyUI choice in Remote > Language Models, for Image descriptions AND Enhancement. Fabio (2026-10-08): deprecate it. Descriptions always come from the Remote pick (ComfyUI = Qwen3-VL-4B abliterated, the default, or a Remote vision model).

FIRST STEP (Fabio): investigate EVERY place the plugin is used and record, per call site, whether it already shows the user a toast when the plugin is missing. The point is that every call gets addressed when the plugin goes, none left failing silently. Known starting points, not a complete list:
- `llmService.describeImage` comfy branch: returns DESCRIBER_MISSING when the plugin is not installed (describeAction.js toasts it; check agentDispatch `_describeImage`).
- `MpiLlmSettings.js` ENHANCER_PLUGIN_ID: the ComfyUI enhance/describe rows lean on the plugin's install state.
- `commandRegistry.js` imageDescribe op (owned by the plugin), plugin menu gating ("NOT installed = absent"), `notificationService.js` plugin install notice, the Model Library Plugins tab.

Then the plugin entry goes, and Qwen3-VL-4B (`qwen3vl-abliterated-clip`) becomes an APP dependency (Fabio, 2026-10-08): installed WITH ComfyUI, never on demand, so the ComfyUI choice in Remote is always ready and has nothing to download or gate on. Do NOT delete the dep entry `qwen3vl-abliterated-clip`: Krea2 shares it and the orphan sweep reads DEPS.

Must land before the Video Edit Flow ships (MPI-1036): that Flow describes its picture through `describeImage`, so a ComfyUI pick without the plugin would error inside the Flow.
